ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)

   B. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

11. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)
